title: Ceiling Share on a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Request Where the Member Buys Their Inputs Here
content:
The share of prior use that fixes the booking ceiling on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts moves with the crop input business the member does with the cooperative and with whether that business is secured. What the member spent on their Crop Input Purchasing Accounts and whether a security interest stands on file against the crop input account decide the line.

1. Where the member's crop input purchases over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach 60000 USD and a security interest stands on file against the crop input account, the programme's ceiling share is raised by 8.0 percentage points.
2. Where those purchases reach 60000 USD and no security interest stands on file against the crop input account, the programme's ceiling share is cut by 15.0 percentage points.
3. Where those purchases fall under 60000 USD, the programme's ceiling share applies as the catalogue writes it.

## What is read

The purchase figure is the money invoiced to the member on their Crop Input Purchasing Accounts over the twelve months ending on the handling date. Whether a security interest stands on file is carried on the crop input account itself.

| Crop input purchases in the window | Security interest on file against the crop input account | The ceiling share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 60000 USD or more | Yes | The programme's ceiling share plus 8.0 |
| 60000 USD or more | No | The programme's ceiling share less 15.0 |
| Under 60000 USD | Either way | The programme's ceiling share, unaltered |

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose ceiling share the catalogue writes at 120 percent, a member with 60000.00 USD of crop input purchases in the window and a security interest on file has a ceiling share of 128.0 percent. The same member without that security interest on file has 105.0 percent. At 59000.00 USD of purchases, the share stands at 120 percent either way.
